mapper.sql: f.favorite_id, f.user_id, f.place_id, f.memo, f.created_at, p.name AS place_name, p.category, p.region, ( SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = f.place_id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order, pi.place_image_id LIMIT 1 ) AS primary_image_url
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorites (user_id, place_id, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{placeId}, #{memo}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, place_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM favorites f JOIN places p ON p.place_id = f.place_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.favorite_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
